question: In which of the following states is the National Sports University located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipur**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Sports University:-**

 
 
• It is India's first institute dedicated to the study of sports science, sports management, sports coaching, and other related fields.
 
• **The university is located in Manipur, a northeastern state of India.**
 
• National Sports University was established by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India in 2018.
 
• **Its objective is to promote sports education in the country and provide specialized knowledge and skills in order to train coaches, sports scientists, and sports managers.**
 
• **It offers various programs:-**
 
 
• 
 
Sports Sciences: This area of study relates to the scientific principles and techniques that can be applied to improve athletic performance.

 
 
• 
 
Sports Coaching: This relates to the strategic, leadership, communication, and motivational skills needed to effectively coach sports teams or individual athletes.

 
 
• 
 
Sports Management: This area of study covers the management of sports teams, sports events, sports marketing, and sports facilities, etc.

 
 
• 
 
Physical Education: This is the study of physical activity and its impact on health, physical competence, and overall wellbeing.

 
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Other Important Institutions of India:- 
 
 
• University of Delhi (DU): Often regarded as one of India's top universities, it offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in a broad array of disciplines.
 
• Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU): Located in Delhi, JNU offers programs in a variety of disciplines, focusing on postgraduate and doctoral level study.
 
• Banaras Hindu University (BHU): Based in Varanasi, this university offers a range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs.
 
• Visva-Bharati University: This is a Central University and an 'Institution of National Importance' located in Santiniketan, West Bengal.
 
• Aligarh Muslim University (AMU): Located in Aligarh, this university is notable for its diverse range of disciplines in undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs.
 
• Jamia Millia Islamia: Located in New Delhi, this university offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral degrees in a wide range of disciplines.
 
• Rajiv Gandhi National University of Law (RGNUL): One of India's top National Law Universities, located in Patiala, Punjab.
